_meta.purpose: Every user-facing UI string in the app (buttons, labels, titles, instructions, error/status messages), pulled out of the source code into one editable file. This is a translation-READY export, not a wired-up translation - the app still reads these strings from the source files, not from this file. Wiring a real i18n library is separate follow-up work.
_meta.howToEdit: Edit the text on the right-hand side of each ": " pair freely. Do NOT change the keys (the short names on the left, like "title" or "confirmButton") - engineering matches strings back to the app by key.
_meta.placeholders: Anything written as {{likeThis}} is filled in by the app at runtime (a name, a number, a count) - keep the {{...}} token exactly as written, in whatever position makes sense in the translated sentence.
_meta.pluralization: A few strings have separate Singular/Plural variants (e.g. subtitleSingular / subtitlePlural) because English changes the sentence depending on a count. Translate each variant to whatever your language's equivalent grammatical form is.
_meta.arrays: Some entries are numbered lists (point1/point2/point3, or step1/step2/step3, or a list of Q&A pairs) - these render in that exact order on screen. Translate the text; don't reorder, add, or remove entries without checking with engineering first.
_meta.excluded: Two things were deliberately left out of this file: (1) the interview question text and talking points shown during recording - those already live in the database in English/Hindi/Marathi and are managed separately, not in app code; (2) developer-only debug UI (a theme switcher and a dev navigation menu) that real distributors never see, plus a handful of placeholder/mock values standing in for data that will come from the backend later (e.g. a sample phone number, a sample distributor ID) - those aren't translatable copy, they're temporary test data.
_meta.notesOnProperNouns: A few entries are names/brand names used in mocked-up screens (e.g. "Vardaan Paints", "Rajesh") rather than general copy - usually fine to leave as-is or transliterate, not translate.
_meta.languageNames: The languageNames block is a special case: each language's name for ITSELF (an endonym). Keep identical across strings.en/hi/mr.json - same convention every app's language picker uses (a Hindi speaker looking for Hindi in an English-language picker still needs to see "हिन्दी", not a translated word for it). Do not translate these three values differently per file.

questionBrief.nervousBody: Talk to the camera like a friend, not an audience. Take a breath before you start. If you stumble, just keep going - the natural version is the good one.

help.faq1Answer: Yes - you can review and re-record any answer before you send everything, and change one afterward from My Videos.
